services.title: Top-to-Bottom Deluxe Cleaning
services.short_description: Our signature hand-detailed deep clean — the recommended starting point for every new recurring client and the right call before a special occasion or spring reset.
services.long_description: We recommend that all recurring customers start with our signature Top to Bottom Deluxe Cleaning. It brings your home to the level where we can easily and efficiently maintain our standard of cleanliness. Our Top to Bottom Deluxe Cleaning is also a great option when getting ready for a special occasion, spring cleaning, or when you just haven't had the time to keep up. It includes every general cleaning item, cleaned by hand with a detailed emphasis and focus on build-up, plus cabinet fronts, doors and door frames, light switch plates, hand-washed blinds, baseboards, and ceiling fan blades within two-step ladder reach.
sub_services: All cabinet fronts hand washed or wiped
Doors, door frames and light switch plates hand washed
Tub, shower and tiles double scrubbed for buildup
Blinds, moldings, windowsills and lock ledges hand washed
Baseboards and ceiling fan blades hand washed within two-step reach
Vacant homes: drawers, shelves and inside cabinets wiped

services.title: Recurring Cleaning Service
services.short_description: Weekly, bi-weekly or monthly service with the same maid every visit, so you always open the door to a fresh house.
services.long_description: A recurring clean is the best way to keep your home always looking its best. Choose from weekly, bi-weekly or monthly service — we can help you decide which best fits your family's needs. To establish recurring service, an initial one-time deep cleaning is performed to get your home to the level where we can easily and efficiently maintain our standard of cleanliness. After the initial cleaning we continue to regularly clean your home for as long as you like. Our environmentally friendly cleaning services clean your house on the surface and deep down as well, and our attention to detail is what homeowners love about our service.
sub_services: Kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living areas

services.title: General House Cleaning
services.short_description: Maintenance cleaning for homes that have had a professional clean within the last four weeks — available weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or one-time.
services.long_description: A general cleaning is recommended if you have had a professional cleaning within the last four weeks. Our general house cleaning services are available for weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or one-time cleanings. We are a total home cleaning solution that combines reliable, dedicated service with the most advanced cleaning tools and technologies. Maintenance cleanings cover ceiling fans and light fixtures, cobwebs, blinds and windowsills, moldings and baseboards, all sinks scrubbed and disinfected, tub and shower tiles, wastebaskets emptied and relined, stairs, furniture dusted and polished, appliance exteriors, stovetop and drip pans, counters and backsplashes, mirrors, bathroom fixtures sanitized, beds made with one set of sheets changed, and floors vacuumed and mopped.
sub_services: Kitchen counters, backsplashes and appliance exteriors
Dusting: fans, fixtures, blinds, moldings, baseboards, furniture
Beds made with one set of sheets changed

services.title: One-Time Cleaning
services.short_description: Guests coming? Moving in or out? Hosting a party? Skip the hassle and let our seasoned professionals handle the whole house in one visit.
services.long_description: We offer two types of one-time cleans at AmeriStar Maids — our signature Top to Bottom Deluxe Clean and a General Clean. It is our job to help you choose the right level of service for your needs. If you are having guests over, moving in or out, or preparing your home for a party, skip the hassle of tidying up and save precious time. Our seasoned professionals can do it all, and a free estimate costs you nothing.

services.title: Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning
services.short_description: Residential cleaning for homes, apartments, vacation rentals and post-construction projects — including move-ins and move-outs.
services.long_description: Home is where the heart is. It is also where everyday dirt and grime lie. AmeriStar Maids is a total-home cleaning solution that combines reliable, dedicated service with the most advanced cleaning tools and technologies. We provide residential cleaning for homes, apartments, move-ins and move-outs, vacation rentals, and post-construction projects. Our house cleaning service starts before any dusting or vacuuming takes place — it begins with a free in-home estimate so we can build a custom cleaning plan around your home. We never take a one-size-fits-all approach.
sub_services: Custom plan built from a free in-home estimate
